package r4id_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	json "encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	sseserver "example.com/r4id/gen/jsonrpc/sse/server"
	wsclient "example.com/r4id/gen/jsonrpc/ws/client"
	wsserver "example.com/r4id/gen/jsonrpc/ws/server"
	sse "example.com/r4id/gen/sse"
	ws "example.com/r4id/gen/ws"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
)

type streamCalls struct {
	sync.Mutex
	ids []string
}

type sseService struct {
	*streamCalls
}

type wsService struct {
	*streamCalls
}

func TestSSEEnvelopeAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, id, params string
		code, calls      int
	}{
		{"valid", `"abc"`, `{"v":"x"}`, 0, 1},
		{"invalid-spoof", `"ABC"`, `{"v":"x","id":"abc"}`, -32602, 0},
		{"numeric", `9007199254740993`, `{"v":"x"}`, 0, 1},
		{"required-notification", ``, `{"v":"x","id":"abc"}`, 0, 0},
		{"null", `null`, `{"v":"x"}`, -32602, 0},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls := &streamCalls{}
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			sseserver.Mount(mux, sseserver.New(sse.NewEndpoints(sseService{calls}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, func(context.Context, http.ResponseWriter, error) {}))
			message := `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":` + tc.params
			if tc.id != "" {
				message += `,"id":` + tc.id
			}
			message += "}"
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/sse", strings.NewReader(message)))
			if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Errorf("status %d: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
			if tc.id == "" {
				if response.Body.Len() != 0 {
					t.Errorf("notification body: %s", response.Body.String())
				}
			} else {
				data := response.Body.String()
				{
					start := strings.Index(data, "data: ")
					if start < 0 {
						t.Fatalf("no SSE data: %s", data)
					}
					data = strings.Split(data[start+len("data: "):], "\n")[0]
				}
				assertEnvelope(t, []byte(data), tc.id, tc.code)
			}
			if calls.count() != tc.calls {
				t.Errorf("calls %d want %d", calls.count(), tc.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestWSEnvelopeAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	calls := &streamCalls{}
	svc := wsService{calls}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	wsserver.Mount(mux, wsserver.New(svc.HandleStream, ws.NewEndpoints(svc), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, func(context.Context, http.ResponseWriter, error) {}, &websocket.Upgrader{}, loomhttp.WebSocketConfig{}))
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	conn, response, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial("ws"+strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "http")+"/ws", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	if err := conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		id, params string
		code       int
	}{
		{`"abc"`, `{"v":"x"}`, 0},
		{`"ABC"`, `{"v":"x","id":"abc"}`, -32602},
		{`9007199254740993`, `{"v":"x"}`, 0},
		{`null`, `{"v":"x"}`, -32602},
	} {
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","id":`+tc.id+`,"params":`+tc.params+`}`)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_, data, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		assertEnvelope(t, data, tc.id, tc.code)
	}
	// An invalid required notification must neither invoke nor reply. The next
	// valid request is a protocol barrier so no timing-based negative check is used.
	if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":{"id":"abc","v":"x"}}`)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","id":"barrier","params":{"v":"x"}}`)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, data, err := conn.ReadMessage()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	assertEnvelope(t, data, `"barrier"`, 0)
	if calls.count() != 3 {
		t.Errorf("calls=%d want3", calls.count())
	}
}

func TestWSClientParamsProjection(t *testing.T) {
	captured := make(chan []byte, 1)
	peerErrors := make(chan error, 1)
	peer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		upgrader := websocket.Upgrader{}
		conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
		if err != nil {
			peerErrors <- err
			return
		}
		defer func() {
			if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
				peerErrors <- err
			}
		}()
		_, data, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			peerErrors <- err
			return
		}
		captured <- data
		// Keep the connection alive until the generated client closes it.
		_, _, err = conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil && !websocket.IsCloseError(err, websocket.CloseNormalClosure, websocket.CloseGoingAway, websocket.CloseAbnormalClosure) && err != io.EOF {
			peerErrors <- err
		}
	}))
	defer peer.Close()
	client := wsclient.NewClient("ws", strings.TrimPrefix(peer.URL, "http://"), peer.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false, websocket.DefaultDialer, loomhttp.WebSocketConfig{})
	defer func() {
		if err := client.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	result, err := client.Watch()(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stream := result.(*wsclient.WatchClientStream)
	if err := stream.SendWithContext(ctx, &ws.WatchPayload{ID: "service-only", V: "x"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case data := <-captured:
		var envelope struct {
			ID     string                    `json:"id"`
			Params map[string]jsontext.Value `json:"params"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &envelope); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if envelope.ID == "" || envelope.ID == "service-only" {
			t.Errorf("runtime-generated ID lost: %s", data)
		}
		if _, present := envelope.Params["id"]; present || string(envelope.Params["v"]) != `"x"` {
			t.Errorf("params projection: %s", data)
		}
	case err := <-peerErrors:
		t.Fatal(err)
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
}

func (s sseService) Watch(ctx context.Context, p *sse.WatchPayload, stream sse.WatchServerStream) error {
	s.record(p.ID)
	return stream.SendAndClose(ctx, p.ID+":"+p.V)
}

func (s wsService) HandleStream(ctx context.Context, stream ws.Stream) error {
	for {
		if err := stream.Recv(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}

func (s wsService) Watch(_ context.Context, p *ws.WatchPayload) (string, error) {
	s.record(p.ID)
	return p.ID + ":" + p.V, nil
}

func assertEnvelope(t *testing.T, data []byte, id string, code int) {
	t.Helper()
	var envelope struct {
		ID     jsontext.Value `json:"id"`
		Result string         `json:"result"`
		Error  *struct {
			Code    int    `json:"code"`
			Message string `json:"message"`
		} `json:"error"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &envelope); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode %s: %v", data, err)
	}
	if string(envelope.ID) != id {
		t.Errorf("echo %s want %s", envelope.ID, id)
	}
	if code == 0 {
		normalized := strings.Trim(id, `"`)
		if envelope.Error != nil || envelope.Result != normalized+":x" {
			t.Errorf("success envelope: %s", data)
		}
	} else if envelope.Error == nil || envelope.Error.Code != code || envelope.Error.Message == "" {
		t.Errorf("error envelope: %s want code %d and detail", data, code)
	}
}

func (s *streamCalls) record(id string) {
	s.Lock()
	defer s.Unlock()
	s.ids = append(s.ids, id)
}

func (s *streamCalls) count() int {
	s.Lock()
	defer s.Unlock()
	return len(s.ids)
}
